note: Cameroon: nationals of the other CEMAC states, Mali and Nigeria enter without a visa for 90 days; everyone else applies online for an e-Visa before entering (issued in about 72 hours; EUR 153 for 180 days, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Prime Minister's services, which confirmed that every visa has been applied for online through evisacam.cm since 30 April 2023; the exemptions stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Cameroon
sources.said: Visitors to Cameroon must obtain an e-Visa unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following seven countries can visit Cameroon without a visa for up to 90 days: Central African Republic Chad Republic of Congo Equatorial Guinea Gabon Mali Nigeria ... As of October 2026 , visitors must obtain transit, short-stay and long-stay visas online before entering Cameroon.

sources.title: Services du Premier Ministre (Cameroun): Conseil de cabinet du mois de juillet 2024
sources.said: Le Cameroun a procédé, le 30 avril 2023 au basculement de la ligne des procédures de délivrance de visas d'entrée sur le territoire national. Désormais, tout usager souhaitant se rendre au Cameroun doit obligatoirement soumettre son dossier en ligne, à partir du portail numérique www.evisacam.cm .
